title: Rahul Tirur
summary: La'Mansion fits a G+3 home with real presence onto a 4-cent urban plot.
story: La'Mansion is a masterclass in urban infill design, proving that a limited 4-cent plot is no barrier to luxury and scale. This contemporary residence maximizes interior volume through a tiered G+3 layout, defined by bold horizontal planes and striking vertical light features that create a prestigious street presence. Large-format glazing invites the surrounding tropical landscape inward, while the minimalist palette of crisp white and textured grey concrete ensures La'Mansion maintains a timeless, sophisticated character.

title: Hamza Venniyoor
summary: An older two-storey house reworked into a calm, white tropical home with a pool and double-height living.
story: Fathima's is a sophisticated transformation that breathes new life into a traditional structure, reimagining it as a minimalist tropical sanctuary. The design is defined by clean horizontal lines and a crisp white facade, beautifully contrasted by warm wood-cladding and integrated architectural lighting. From the serene outdoor pool with its textured stone feature wall to the expansive, double-height interiors featuring polished marble floors and bespoke fluted paneling, every detail reflects a seamless blend of luxury and functional simplicity.

title: Shareef Chelari
summary: A traditional house renovated with a modern, minimal finish that keeps its original character.
story: Breathing New Life into Classic Spaces. We specialize in the art of residential renovation, blending the timeless charm of traditional structures with modern, minimalist aesthetics. From revitalizing interiors like "Fathima’s House" to complete structural overhauls, our team at Novart Architects ensures every renovation respects the original soul of the home while introducing contemporary luxury and functionality.

title: Contemporary Tropical Residence
summary: Bold forms, double-height living and daylit rooms that stay connected to the garden.
story: A refined contemporary residence designed with a balance of modern luxury, openness, and tropical warmth. The project features bold architectural forms, double-height living spaces, elegant material palettes, and naturally lit interiors that create a calm and sophisticated living experience. Every space is thoughtfully planned to combine aesthetics, comfort, and functionality while maintaining a strong connection with landscape and natural elements.

title: Thanseem Vanimel
summary: A family home with a grand entrance, double-height living and warm, detailed interiors.
story: Designed for modern lifestyles, this residence showcases the perfect balance between sophistication and simplicity. Every element—from the grand entrance and double-height living area to the serene bedrooms and bespoke interiors—has been carefully curated to create spaces that inspire comfort and elegance.
Natural materials, refined finishes, warm lighting, and meticulous detailing define the character of this home, resulting in an environment that is both visually striking and deeply functional.
